evidence: Collectively, these results demonstrate that the phosphomimetic LCD variants 12D and 12DD reproduce the essential feature of phosphorylation-driven micellization, forming spherical micelles above a low-micromolar CMC with concentration-independent sizes, underscoring the role of C-terminal charge in redirecting self-organization.
